manual.title: User Manual
manual.subtitle: Detailed help guide for using and administering the GesPT platform.

course_view.title: View Course
course_view.desc: View detailed course information, including the list of Curricular Units (UCs) and associated Study Plans.
course_view.steps:
1. Go to the Home page of the platform.
2. Use the search bar to filter courses by name, acronym, or code.
3. Click on the course card or 'Course Details' to view more information.

course_create.title: Create Course
course_create.desc: Create a new course in the platform's general catalog.
course_create.steps:
1. On the Home page, click the '+ New course' button in the top-right corner.
2. In the modal, fill in the Name (PT), Name (EN), Acronym, and Code.
3. Click 'Save' to finalize creation.

course_edit.title: Edit Course
course_edit.desc: Modify metadata of an existing course (such as names or acronym).
course_edit.steps:
1. Open the details page of the course you wish to edit.
2. Click the 'Edit Course' button on the top panel.
3. Update the form data in the editing modal.
4. Click 'Save' to register changes.

course_delete.title: Delete Course
course_delete.desc: Permanently delete a course along with all its UCs and associated study plans.
course_delete.steps:
1. Open the corresponding course details page.
2. Click 'Delete Course' in the top-right corner.
3. Carefully read the confirmation warning and confirm the permanent deletion.

uc_view.title: View UC
uc_view.desc: Consult academic details of a Curricular Unit, such as contact hours breakdown and study plans it belongs to.
uc_view.steps:
1. Go to the details page of the course the UC belongs to.
2. In the Curricular Units table, click on the name of the desired UC.
3. You will be redirected to the page displaying contact hours and workload distribution.

uc_create.title: Create UC
uc_create.desc: Add a new Curricular Unit to a course.
uc_create.steps:
1. Go to the course details page.
2. In the header of the UC table, click the 'Add UC' button.
3. Fill in the name, acronym, ECTS, semester, year, and detailed hours breakdown fields.
4. Click 'Create & Add UC'.

uc_edit.title: Edit UC
uc_edit.desc: Change Curricular Unit details or configure optional UCs associated with it.
uc_edit.steps:
1. Go to the details page of the corresponding UC.
2. At the top-right, click the 'Edit' button.
3. Modify the desired information in the input fields or the UC Options section.
4. Click 'Save' to register changes.

uc_delete.title: Delete UC
uc_delete.desc: Remove a Curricular Unit from a course.
uc_delete.steps:
1. Go to the details page of the course the UC belongs to.
2. In the UCs table, click the trash can icon ('Delete UC') on the UC's row.
3. Confirm permanent deletion in the dialog box.

plan_view_compare.title: View/Compare Study Plan
plan_view_compare.desc: View and perform comparative analysis of equivalences and discontinued UCs between two study plans.
plan_view_compare.steps:
1. Click the 'Comparison' link in the main navigation menu.
2. Select the Course, Initial study plan, and Target study plan.
3. Analyze the equivalences table. Click 'Export to Excel' or 'Export to PDF' to download the report.

plan_create.title: Create Study Plan
plan_create.desc: Use the guided Wizard to create a curriculum study plan with structured UCs and equivalences.
plan_create.steps:
1. Click 'Create study plan' in the navigation menu.
2. Step 1 (Course): Select an existing course or click to create a new one.
3. Step 2 (Info): Define the study plan name, academic year (e.g. 2026/2027), and dates.
4. Step 3 (UCs): Add UCs (existing or new) and specify semester/ECTS.
5. Step 4 (Equivalences): Select the previous plan and map equivalences.
6. Click 'Save study plans'.

plan_edit.title: Edit Study Plan
plan_edit.desc: Update details and structure of an existing study plan using the guided Wizard.
plan_edit.steps:
1. Go to the details page of the associated course.
2. In the Study Plans table, click the 'Edit study plan' button (pencil icon) for that plan.
3. In the wizard, update the necessary UCs or equivalences.
4. Click 'Save study plans'.

plan_delete.title: Delete Study Plan
plan_delete.desc: Remove a study plan from the system.
plan_delete.steps:
1. Go to the corresponding course details page.
2. In the Study Plans table, click the trash can icon for the plan.
3. Confirm permanent deletion in the dialog box.

user_view.title: View User
user_view.desc: Consult the list of authorized users in the platform.
user_view.steps:
1. Click 'Administration' in the top navigation menu.
2. Open the 'Authentication and Users' tab.
3. View the complete list in the Authorized access list table. Use the search field to filter by name or email.

user_create.title: Create User
user_create.desc: Add a new local or remote user to the authorized access list.
user_create.steps:
1. In the Administration panel, under 'Authentication and Users', click the '+ Add' (or '+ Add entry') button.
2. Fill in the Name, Email, Account Type (Remote SSO or Local), Password, and Recovery Email.
3. Click 'Save' to register the user.

user_edit.title: Edit User
user_edit.desc: Update user information and configure their assigned roles and custom permissions.
user_edit.steps:
1. Locate the user in the user table under the Administration panel.
2. Click the corresponding pencil icon.
3. In the editing modal, change information and select/uncheck desired roles and custom permissions.
4. Click 'Save' to register changes.

user_block.title: Block User
user_block.desc: Temporarily block a user from accessing the platform.
user_block.steps:
1. Locate the user in the user table under the Administration panel.
2. Click the lock icon on the corresponding user row.
3. In the confirmation modal, optionally enter a blocking reason.
4. Click 'Block'. The user will now display a closed lock icon.

user_delete.title: Delete User
user_delete.desc: Permanently remove a user account from the platform.
user_delete.steps:
1. Locate the user in the user table under the Administration panel.
2. Click the trash can icon corresponding to the user.
3. Confirm deletion in the dialog box.

role_view.title: View Roles
role_view.desc: Consult configured roles and permissions on the platform.
role_view.steps:
1. Go to 'Administration' in the top menu.
2. Select the 'Role Management' tab.
3. View roles, descriptions, and the number of associated users.

role_create.title: Create Role
role_create.desc: Create a new role to group access permissions.
role_create.steps:
1. Under 'Role Management', click the '+ Add Role' button.
2. Enter the Role Name, Description, and select associated permissions from the checklist.
3. Click 'Save Role'.

role_edit.title: Edit Role
role_edit.desc: Modify details or permissions associated with an existing role.
role_edit.steps:
1. Under 'Role Management', locate the role in the list and click the pencil icon.
2. In the modal, edit the name, description, and adjust the permissions selection.
3. Click 'Save Role'.

role_assign.title: Assign Role
role_assign.desc: Associate roles directly with users or define default rules by email domain.
role_assign.steps:
1. Direct: edit the user in the admin panel and select the desired role from the dropdown.
2. Auto-assign: configure a 'Default role' in the accepted domains list, which applies automatically on first successful login.

domain_add.title: Add Domain
domain_add.desc: Authorize an institutional email domain to register or authenticate on the platform.
domain_add.steps:
1. Go to 'Administration' and open the 'Authentication and Users' tab.
2. In the left panel form, type the email domain (e.g. ipleiria.pt) in the input field.
3. Click the 'Add' (or 'Add entry') button.

domain_edit.title: Edit Domain
domain_edit.desc: Configure the default role automatically assigned to new users from a domain.
domain_edit.steps:
1. Open the 'Accepted Domains' panel in the 'Authentication and Users' tab.
2. Locate the domain and use the 'Default role' dropdown to select the target role.
3. The change is saved dynamically in the system.

domain_remove.title: Remove Domain
domain_remove.desc: Deauthorize an email domain, preventing new logins from users with that domain.
domain_remove.steps:
1. Open the 'Accepted Domains' panel in the 'Authentication and Users' tab.
2. Locate the domain and click the corresponding trash can icon.
3. Confirm removal (note: base domains like 'gespt.local' cannot be removed).

audit_view.title: View Audit
audit_view.desc: Consult detailed logs of critical actions and changes executed on the platform for security purposes.
audit_view.steps:
1. Go to 'Administration' and click the 'Audit Logs' tab.
2. Use the filter buttons at the top to narrow down results (e.g. failed logins, database changes, access control).
3. Click 'Show details' to view detailed JSON data for any log entry.
